items.title: Clark Terry interviewed by Joe Williams and Michael Woods, Clinton, New York, May 19, 1995
items.q: What was Mr. Low Blow’s name? What was his name?

ctx.x: Jesse Miller. And that front line, he had Washington on saxophone and wound up with [inaudible] playing lead.
What was Mr. Low Blow’s name? What was his name?

Mack Easton, baritone player. Yeah. But he had Ed Cytouff playing in there, Johnny Avant and Cytouff the two trombones, but two trumpets, two trombones, and four saxes. Yeah, four, I think it was four. Four or three. And the piano, bass and drums, and guitar sometimes too.
